newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Bunds to consolidate then try for 100.30.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Bunds to consolidate then try for 100.30.

text.p: June Bund futures will aim to consolidate near term around 100.18 before heading for the 100.25, 30 area on Friday, technical analysts said.

"Yesterday we saw a third (Elliott) wave finishing to the downside at 99.55, then a smaller 'a' wave to the upside to 99.84 and a 'b' wave to the downside to 99.52," said Martin Siegert, derivatives portfolio manager at Landesgirokasse in Stuttgart.
"We are now in the 'c' wave to the upside and have almost reached the first target at 100.18," he said.
At 0811 GMT, June Bunds were at 100.15, up 0.47 on the day.
"We should see some sideways and consolidative action then. If we break 100.18, 100.25 to 100.30 will be a good target," Siegert added.
For this session, analysts said the opening level around 100.03 would provide good support.
Siegert noted a further prop below that at 99.93.
Longer term, he said Bunds would look to further strengthening in the next few days before sliding lower.
"There should be more consolidation on Friday, Monday and Tuesday and then we will see Bunds move down to around the 99.00 area and perhaps below 99 the figure," said Siegert.

Anil Patel, technical analyst at Nomura International in London, said Bunds would look to U.S. Treasuries for a lead, but the downside risk was still there, with a double bottom on continuation charts coming in at 99.28.
To the upside, he said Bunds needed to break 100.41 and trade into the 100.60s.
"If we can get up to 100.86 we could re-introduce the slight potential of a bull drive thereafter," he said. "But I doubt very much that will happen today."
He said with both month and quarter ending next week, liquidation was more or less over.
"I don't think people will be taking any real strong open long positions at the moment," Patel said.
At the short end, June Euromarks were unchanged on the day at 96.68.
Analysts at a European bank in London said the scope remained for some short term stability.
But they said a push through 96.74/75 would help stimualate more of a short squeeze.
